name: lifetime_c05
description: C05: runLifetimeAnalysis3D ('overwrite' true: the tracks read again) and plotIntensityCohorts on the demo condition (3 experiments, 2 channels, 60 frames; MATLAB's ProcessedTracks.mat of a demo run), as the multiple-experiments demo calls them (MATLAB with its JVM: the condition loader and the figures need it), against run_lifetime_analysis and plot_intensity_cohorts. Inputs from PK5D_C05_FRAMES (the demo condition's frames) and PK5D_C05_TRACKS (a demo run's experiments with their tracks, as in PetaKit5D_point_detection_demo_tracks), set with brun.sh -v.
